methods: Retrieved every DOI primary registration record, with 429 retries performed serially.
Compared title, complete ordered author names (explicit others markers accepted), venue/publisher, and supported print/online year.

Checked every non-DOI record against source manuscript, originating institution, official publisher, or repository. One manuscript lacks a locatable authoritative record and software formal citation remains partial.
Ran original checker logic on cached live-fetched Crossref records, preserving original parser; separately exercised unavailable-metadata behavior without network.
limitations: Bibliographic identity/metadata audit, not verification that each cited paper supports each scientific claim.
Registry metadata can itself be incomplete; manually investigated all comparison flags and retained documented equivalent-name/subtitle/date variants.
No journal submission status independently verified for unpublished manuscripts.
Ancillary pagination/volume fields screened against metadata, not a full image-by-image pagination audit.
